verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: saritaa sarovar salil mil ek bhe ek sai anek hot kaise niravaaro jee ||

en.bdb: When the water of river and lake meet, they become indistinguishable. Then how can they be disintegrated into their earlier form when they have become one?

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਚੂਨਾ ਕਾਥਾ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਏ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਭਏ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: paan choonaa kaathaa supaaree khaae sura(n)g bhe bahur na chatur baran bisathaaro jee ||

en.bdb: Chewing beetle leaf, catechu, lime and beetle nut produces deep red colour. But then none of these ingredients can be separated from that red colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਮੈ ਅਨਿਕ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਗੋਤਾਚਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: paaras paras hot kanik anik dhaat kanik mai anik na hot gotaachaaro jee ||

en.bdb: Many metals turn into gold by a touch of the philosopher-stone. Thereafter they cannot revert back to their original form.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥੯੩॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan subaas kai subaasanaa banaasapatee bhagat jagat pat bisam bichaaro jee ||93||

en.bdb: The sandalwood tree imparts fragrance to all the other trees around it. That fragrance cannot then be taken away from them. Similarly the union of the Lord and his devotees is a very strange and astonishing tale. They become one and there is no duality left. (93)
